text.tspan: Measures 108–120: Large descending sequence and circle-of-fifths return.
Practice 108–110, 111–113, 114–116, and 117–120; give special attention to the connection 116→117.
Measures 121–128: Compressed harmonic rhythm — several harmonic events are packed into short spans.
Practice 121–122, 123–124, 125–126, and 127–128; first reduce each pair to its structural notes, then restore the sixteenths.
Measures 129–136: Final sequential and cadential progression back to G minor.
Practice 129–133 and 134–136, then play 129–136 as one uninterrupted arrival at the final tonic.
